stem.text: Acrolein is an organic compound with the molecular formula $\text{C}_3\text{H}_4\text{O}$. It is used in water treatment and as a herbicide. When acrolein reacts with 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine an orange precipitate is obtained. Reaction of acrolein with Tollens’ reagent produces a silver mirror.

items: Acrolein reacts with alkaline aqueous iodine to produce a yellow precipitate.
Acrolein can be reduced to a primary alcohol.
